description: This file defines a template class 'MeasurementType' used for tracking statistical measurements (min, max, last, average, count) of a generic data type. It includes methods for resetting, setting new values, and retrieving measurement statistics. The class is part of the WPEFramework::Core namespace and depends on external modules 'Number' and 'Module'.

classes.name: MeasurementType
classes.description: A template class for measuring and tracking statistical data (min, max, last, average, count) of a specific data type.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets all measurement statistics to their initial state.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Updates the measurement statistics with a new value.

methods.name: Average
methods.description: Returns the average of all recorded values.

methods.name: Measurements
methods.description: Returns the total number of measurements taken.
